body.x: Automobile Convergence Alliance introduced various business models by participating at ‘2017 Korea Electronics Show(KES)’ which is hosted at Samsung-dong Coex for 4 days from 17th of October(Tues) to 20th(Fri).

Automobile Convergence Alliance is comprised of 4 departments, each named automotive Electronics department, Emotions department, Green(eco) department, Law/System department, every department’s administrated by Korea’s most professionalized institutes. This organization is taking on the role of discovering market-linking business, conferences, finding converging items, reviewing laws and systems etc.

In 2017 KES, Daechang Motors Co. Ltd., Ranix Co. Ltd., MCNEX Co. Ltd., SL Co. Ltd., ESP Co. Ltd., E-intelligence Co. Ltd., Tinnos Co. Ltd., Hancom MDS Co. Ltd., executive office of alliance etc. made up Automobile Convergence Alliance joint-exhibition.

Daechang Motors Co. Ltd., in particular drew many people’s attention, even a VIP attended its booth. Daechang Motors Co. Ltd is a specialized electric car developing and selling company. In this exhibition, it introduced a very small-sized electric car, ‘DANIGO’ a car which can traverse 100km with 1 recharge. Many visitors eagerly went for a trial ride as its performance and design was superb.

Meanwhile, KES 2017, hosted by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy and sponsored by KEA (Korea Electronics Association), is an international show where lots of potential buyers, governments, group officials participate, providing a good place to experience world first products like mobile phone, semiconductor, display, and next generation convergence solutions like industrial convergence, IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education and e health.
